title: dendrobium ciliferum
intro: Dendrobium ciliferum, commonly known as the "Golden Orchid", is a type of flowering orchid plant native to China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium ciliferum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
